map.The wobble has a name: mean absolute dev: The wobble has a name: mean absolute deviation. MAD = mean distance from the data to the mean. Small MAD: calm data. Large MAD: wild data.
map.A deviation is a distance from the mean: A deviation is a distance from the mean. It is always positive. The mean of the distances is the MAD.
